summary: [standards] why_summary returns an empty summary and the missing-Why diagnostic for a proposal.md that has ## Why plus two known canon headings (e.g. ## Acceptance and ## Out of scope): the shared parser now reads it as a PRD brief, finds no Intent, and returns before the ## Why scan. 0.30 needed a canon:section intent marker, so this is new. Fix: fall through to the ## Why scan when intent_summary is None.
